PlayerRole.description: The assigned role of a player. New specialized roles can be added here.

RoomStatus.description: The current lifecycle state of a room. LOBBY is the initial state before the first map exists. MAP_SETUP: the host is creating/editing the map. MAP_READY: a valid map has been saved and the game can start. ENDED is kept for backwards compatibility with earlier drafts; new games use GAME_OVER.

MeetingPhase.description: Sub-state of an active meeting. DISCUSSION: no voting yet. VOTING: votes accepted until deadline or quorum.

RoomType.description: Game function the host assigns to a real room on the map. These are metadata for now; special mechanics may be implemented per type later.
